proof_body:
by
  intro 𝕜 _ H _ _ _ T x y hT hy hx
  have h := T.tendsto_birkhoffAverage_orthogonalProjection hT x
  have he : (((T : H →ₗ[𝕜] H).eqLocus (1 : H →L[𝕜] H)).orthogonalProjectionOnto x : H) = y := by
    rw [← Submodule.starProjection_apply]
    refine Submodule.eq_starProjection_of_mem_orthogonal (by simpa using hy) ?_
    rw [Submodule.mem_orthogonal]
    intro v hv
    exact hx v (by simpa using hv)
  rw [he] at h
  refine h.congr fun n => ?_
  simp [birkhoffAverage, birkhoffSum]
target_source: ∀ (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 H] [CompleteSpace H] (T : H →L[𝕜] H) (x y : H), ‖T‖ ≤ 1 → T y = y → (∀ v, T v = v → inner 𝕜 v (x - y) = 0) → Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n : 𝕜)⁻¹ • ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (T ^ k) x) Filter.atTop (nhds y)
